title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Suriname
summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Suriname. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Bolivia
summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Santa Cruz and Cochabamba Departments, Bolivia. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.
